brandbook.positioning: Identidad original propuesta para una pastelería ficticia en Cali: tortas para compartir y postres para recoger, con elección clara, precios de ejemplo y registro verificable de encargos de demostración. No representa una identidad comercial oficial ni un establecimiento documentado.
brandbook.voice: Cálida, directa y colombiana. Usar “Encargar”, “Hacer pedido”, “Recoger” y explicaciones cortas, sin exageraciones ni garantías inventadas. Un aviso de demostración por página; aclaraciones operativas solo donde ayudan a decidir o recuperar una acción.
brandbook.motif: Vitrina frontal con dos laterales unidos a un margen inferior sólido, bandejas completas y ondas de crema. El margen es el borde de trabajo que une producto, especificación y acción. Dibujos SVG planos diferencian los cuatro productos, sin simular fotografías ni sugerir cantidades por su representación.

pages.title: Brand guidelines
pages.summary: Identidad original propuesta para una pastelería ficticia en Cali: tortas para compartir y postres para recoger, con elección clara, precios de ejemplo y registro verificable de encargos de demostración.

examples.text: Tortas para compartir. Postres para recoger.

examples.title: Cover composition
examples.text: Keep the name dominant, the two-wave symbol secondary and the guide label small. Do not introduce a product illustration on the cover.

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Use a Mora chapter divider with a short statement in Merengue. Introduce the frontal display as the organizing idea, not as a picture of actual premises.

examples.title: Elegir. Encargar. Recoger.
examples.text: Masa Dulce brings product, specification and action together along one clear working edge.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: One notice per web page
examples.text: Demostración ficticia: productos, precios, disponibilidad e imágenes ilustrativos

examples.title: Scope
examples.text: The name, example catalog, pickup policy, palette and typefaces come from the project brief. Do not add an address, reviews, contacts or operational guarantees.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Read from identity to application. Preserve this sequence so composition and editorial decisions are established before interface or print studies.

examples.title: 01–22 · Identity and typography
examples.text: Cover, brand foundations, voice, logo, typography and layouts.

examples.title: 23–49 · Expression and applications
examples.text: Colors, graphic elements, illustration direction, application studies and closing credits.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Build recognition through a frontal display: Merengue interior, Mora sides and a connected lower edge. Keep the title outside the scene and product information below the trays.

examples.title: A single working edge
examples.text: Torta de chocolate · Entera, 8 porciones orientativas · $68.000 · Encargar

examples.title: Chosen direction
examples.text: Use the frontal display, not a recipe notebook or celebration table. Avoid split heroes, interchangeable card grids and cream/serif/terracotta styling.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express project intent rather than an invented corporate mission. Lead with clear selection and explain pickup without claims about quality, heritage or guaranteed service.

examples.title: Tortas para compartir
examples.text: Explora las presentaciones, consulta la disponibilidad y elige qué recoger.

examples.title: Un encargo claro
examples.text: Revisa los productos y la recogida antes de registrar tu pedido de demostración.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Use clarity, care and honesty as design criteria for this project, not claimed company values. Give availability, quantities and uncertain outcomes explicit language.

examples.title: Clarity
examples.text: “Individual” describes the cheesecake. “Entera, 8 porciones orientativas” describes each whole cake; the illustration never defines quantity.

examples.title: Honesty
examples.text: Use “No pudimos confirmar el resultado” when registration is uncertain, never “Pedido registrado” before an authorized server response.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write warm, direct Colombian Spanish. Use short sentences, familiar action verbs and specific next steps. Avoid exaggerated sweetness, pressure, invented guarantees and technical jargon.

examples.title: Preferred vocabulary
examples.text: Encargar · Hacer pedido · Recoger · Revisar pedido · Registrar pedido

examples.title: Helpful correction
examples.text: Esta franja está completa. Elige otra hora o consulta otro día.

examples.title: Avoid
examples.text: Replace “¡El mejor postre de Cali, garantizado!” with “Consulta las tortas y los postres disponibles”.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Open the logo chapter on Mora with Merengue type. Present the name and two cream waves as complementary elements; never turn the symbol into a letter or a cake illustration.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: A wide typographic name, paired with two parallel cream waves.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The identity combines live Bricolage Grotesque 700 lettering with the original two-wave SVG. Use a Pistacho study background and a Merengue support surface behind the complete symbol.

examples.title: Full signature
examples.text: Place the waves to the left of “Masa Dulce”. Align the symbol optically with the name rather than the bottom of its SVG canvas.

examples.title: Compact signature
examples.text: Use the waves alone for the application icon. Keep “Masa Dulce” as the adjacent visible name or accessible label.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Render Masa Dulce in mixed case, Bricolage Grotesque 700, with compact spacing and no distortion. Set the primary signature in Mora on Merengue.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: Use a 32 px symbol canvas beside a 24 px Masa Dulce wordmark, separated by 8 px. Let navigation wrap or reflow rather than compress the name.

examples.title: Dark application
examples.text: Use Merengue lettering on Cacao. Keep the original Mora symbol unchanged on its Merengue support surface.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Reserve clear space equal to one quarter of the symbol canvas on every side of the lockup. Keep illustration trays, borders and control labels outside this space.

examples.title: Header spacing
examples.text: A 32 px symbol canvas establishes an 8 px outer safezone. Measure from the complete lockup, including the name.

examples.title: Print spacing
examples.text: A 16 mm symbol canvas establishes a 4 mm safezone. Do not let a packaging fold or seal edge enter it.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Prefer Mora on Merengue for the full identity. On Pistacho or dark fields, retain the symbol geometry and Mora fill on a Merengue support surface; do not recolor individual waves.

examples.title: Light combination
examples.text: Merengue #FFF9FD background, Mora #492044 name and symbol, Cacao #352724 supporting copy.

examples.title: Dark combination
examples.text: Cacao #352724 field, Merengue #FFF9FD name, original Mora symbol on Merengue. Keep Guayaba away from small lettering.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Use the supplied original SVG as one indivisible symbol: two parallel rounded cream waves in a 160 × 160 viewBox. Share the exact geometry across the header, favicon and application icon.

examples.title: Small symbol
examples.text: Keep both waves visible at 24 px. Use a clear Merengue surround; do not crop one wave to make the mark appear larger.

examples.title: Large symbol
examples.text: On a poster, enlarge the whole SVG proportionally. Keep product trays separate so the mark does not become an illustration topping.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline, crop or decorate the lockup. Preserve the name exactly and avoid replacing the original waves with emoji, stock bakery icons or a boxed initial.

examples.title: Name integrity
examples.text: Use “Masa Dulce”, not “MASADULCE”, “Masa dulce” or “MD” as a replacement wordmark.

examples.title: Geometry integrity
examples.text: Do not separate the waves, add a third wave, fill one in Guayaba or attach candles to the symbol.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use this divider to demonstrate the contrast between wide, compact headlines and open reading text. Bricolage Grotesque leads; Source Sans 3 explains.

examples.title: Algo para compartir
examples.text: Elige una torta entera o un postre individual para recoger.

examples.title: Divider setting
examples.text: Set the headline in Bricolage Grotesque 700 on Mora. Keep the Source Sans 3 supporting line short and in Merengue.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use the supplied Bricolage Grotesque and Source Sans 3 files. Reserve the first for identity and headings, the second for reading, prices, forms and status labels.

examples.title: Tortas y postres para recoger
examples.text: Consulta las presentaciones y la disponibilidad antes de hacer tu pedido.

examples.title: Family roles
examples.text: Bricolage Grotesque 700: Masa Dulce and section titles. Source Sans 3 400: descriptions and fields; 600: actions and short emphasis.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Set Bricolage Grotesque 700 at 64 px for the desktop hero and 36 px for section headings or compact views. Use tight line breaks without squeezing or horizontally scaling letters.

examples.title: Tortas para compartir
examples.text: Chocolate o vainilla con frutos rojos: consulta las opciones disponibles.

examples.title: Headline composition
examples.text: Break after “para” only when the full phrase needs two lines. Keep the headline above the display, never over the chocolate cake.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use weight and style deliberately: headings and wordmark 700, body 400, controls 600 and quiet metadata 400. Prefer upright text; do not use faux bold or italics to signal status.

examples.title: Revisa tu pedido
examples.text: Comprueba los productos, las cantidades y la hora de recogida antes de registrar.

examples.title: Weight specimen
examples.text: Set “Revisar pedido” in Source Sans 3 600. Keep explanatory sentences at 400 and reserve Bricolage Grotesque 700 for the heading.

examples.title: Status style
examples.text: Render “En preparación” upright with a visible label and optional icon. Do not rely on bold, italics or color alone.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 at 16 px for reading and fields, at least 14 px for buttons and at least 12 px for secondary text. Use readable line spacing and tabular numerals in specifications.

examples.title: Fecha y hora de recogida
examples.text: Elige un día y consulta las franjas disponibles.

examples.title: Price and presentation
examples.text: Brownie de cacao · Individual · $8.000. Keep the price aligned with its product and retain full names when lines wrap.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Order information as heading, selected product, specification, action and supporting guidance. Establish hierarchy with scale and spacing, not a proliferation of type sizes or repeated totals.

examples.title: Tu selección
examples.text: Torta de chocolate · Entera, 8 porciones orientativas · Cantidad: 1 · Total: $68.000

examples.title: Reading sequence
examples.text: Use a 36 px heading, 16 px specification and a 14 px minimum action label. Put “Revisar pedido” before the date and contact fields in normal flow.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64 spacing scale. Connect display sides to the lower edge. On desktop use compact alternatives, not card grids; at tablet width four chosen items use 2 × 2.

examples.title: Desktop display
examples.text: At 1440 px, let the scene span the editorial width. Keep the chocolate hero unique, followed by a compact alternatives strip.

examples.title: Compact display
examples.text: At 390 × 640, target 48 px navigation, 64 title/notice, 140 scene, 92 edge and 152 date/slot group. These are budgets, never clipping heights.

examples.title: Flexible content
examples.text: At 768 px, place specification and action below four chosen items. Long names, notes and errors expand in flow; never add an overlapping dock.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Introduce the palette on a Mora divider. Use the five semantic colors as the structural system and retain Guayaba as a sixth, complementary decorative accent.

examples.title: A clear display
examples.text: Merengue opens the scene. Mora anchors its edges. Cacao carries the reading text.

examples.title: Accent restraint
examples.text: Use Pistacho for a quiet support panel and Guayaba for a small berry detail, not for competing primary buttons.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all six hex values. The muted role is named Aviso and serves readable caution copy, not disabled text. Pair light surfaces with Mora or Cacao and label every state in words.

examples.title: Structural tokens
examples.text: Background Merengue #FFF9FD · Surface Pistacho #D9E4B5 · Accent Mora #492044.

examples.title: Reading and detail tokens
examples.text: Text Cacao #352724 · Muted/Aviso #8A4100 · Complementary Guayaba #DB5376.

examples.title: Control pairing
examples.text: Use Merengue text on Mora buttons. Use Aviso on Merengue for warnings; Guayaba is not small text on Merengue.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep semantic tokens at their exact values. Use light Mora tints over Merengue only for decorative separators or quiet panels; never tint text, focus indicators or availability into ambiguity.

examples.title: Quiet support
examples.text: A 10% Mora overlay on Merengue may group “Presentaciones”. Keep its heading and body text in solid Mora or Cacao.

examples.title: State clarity
examples.text: For “Pausado”, use a solid readable label and disabled action. Do not fade the entire product until its name or illustration becomes hard to recognize.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Use connected display sides, complete trays and cream waves as the graphic vocabulary. Move the selected tray and its specification together for 220 ms; keep frame and controls anchored.

examples.title: Frontal construction
examples.text: Build a Merengue rectangle with Mora sides physically meeting its solid lower edge. Price, availability and Encargar belong on that edge.

examples.title: Selection movement
examples.text: Selecting Cheesecake de maracuyá changes its tray and specification together. With reduced motion, replace immediately; invalid input never moves the last valid scene.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple, consistent icons with visible labels for actions and states. Keep the wave symbol exclusive to identity. Use 24 px icon canvases inside controls with at least 44 px touch targets.

examples.title: Named actions
examples.text: Pair a calendar icon with “Fecha de recogida” and a directional icon with “Ver detalle”. Never make an unlabeled cake icon the only ordering control.

examples.title: Readable states
examples.text: Pair a pause icon with “Pausado” and a check with “Listo”. Use clear focus and control boundaries with at least 3:1 contrast.

pages.title: Product illustration
pages.summary: Replace photography with deliberately flat SVG drawings. Maintain four canonical products, complete trays and version-consistent silhouettes across catalog, review and saved confirmation.

examples.title: Whole cakes
examples.text: Show Torta de chocolate with Cacao coverage and Torta de vainilla y frutos rojos with a light top and Guayaba berries. Both remain whole, never cut open.

examples.title: Individual desserts
examples.text: Show Cheesecake de maracuyá with a flat Aviso-colored top and Brownie de cacao as a distinct Cacao block. Give each SVG its full accessible product name.

examples.title: Representation limits
examples.text: A drawing identifies the product, not stock or unit count. Saved orders retain the presentation version associated with their frozen lines.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Assemble a code-drawn board of wide typography, frontal frames, flat toppings and orderly specifications. Exclude raster images, photorealism, invented interiors and celebratory table scenes.

examples.title: Include
examples.text: Mora display edge, Merengue plane, chocolate silhouette, two cream waves and a neatly aligned “$68.000 · Encargar” strip.

examples.title: Exclude
examples.text: No flour-dusted photography, vintage recipe paper, terracotta serif labels, balloons or automatically animated entrances.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Label every application as a design study in its presentation caption. Carry the same frame, name, waves and type hierarchy into each medium without implying an implemented feature.

examples.title: Elige algo para compartir
examples.text: Consulta las tortas y los postres disponibles para recoger.

examples.title: Design study · Shared system
examples.text: Use the product above and useful information below. A print piece may echo the lower edge, but must not suggest a working button or payment service.

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: use the unchanged wave SVG on a Merengue avatar field. Allow generous circular-crop clearance and omit tiny lettering, product art and decorative borders.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: Tortas para compartir y postres para recoger.

examples.title: Design study · Avatar
examples.text: Center a 64 px symbol canvas within a 96 px Merengue field. Keep both waves intact in square and circular previews.

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: pair the wave avatar with the exact name and a brief descriptive bio. Do not invent a handle, contact channel, verified badge, address or audience count.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: Pastelería ficticia en Cali. Tortas y postres de demostración para recoger.

examples.title: Design study · Profile header
examples.text: Set the name first, description second and catalog reference last. Use the frontal frame in the banner without repeating the full homepage hero.

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Design study: show one canonical product per post, with a short heading above and presentation below. Keep price examples secondary and direct readers to current catalog availability.

examples.title: Chocolate para compartir
examples.text: Torta de chocolate · Entera, 8 porciones orientativas · Precio de ejemplo: $68.000 COP. Consulta la disponibilidad en el catálogo.

examples.title: Un postre individual
examples.text: Cheesecake de maracuyá · Individual · Precio de ejemplo: $14.000 COP.

examples.title: Design study · Post layout
examples.text: Use a Merengue field, Mora lower edge and one complete tray. Keep captions clear of the product silhouette.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: use one large headline, one product drawing and one lower information band. Let the wordmark identify the poster without adding fabricated store details or scannable destinations.

examples.title: Tortas para compartir
examples.text: Chocolate o vainilla con frutos rojos. Consulta presentaciones y disponibilidad en el catálogo.

examples.title: Design study · Poster hierarchy
examples.text: Place the heading above the display. Give the complete cake most of the central plane and use the lower edge for the catalog invitation.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: favor a single Mora signature on a Merengue-colored field. Use a support patch on dark fabric and keep the mark away from seams, folds and handles.

examples.title: Algo para compartir
examples.text: Masa Dulce

examples.title: Design study · Tote
examples.text: Center the waves above the name with a full safezone. Keep the reverse plain rather than adding prices, a menu or an invented address.

pages.title: Takeaway packaging
pages.summary: Design study: keep the lid calm, with the identity above a frontal-edge label. State product and presentation in text; do not invent materials, food certifications or storage instructions.

examples.title: Torta de vainilla y frutos rojos
examples.text: Entera, 8 porciones orientativas · Masa Dulce

examples.title: Design study · Individual sleeve
examples.text: Use “Brownie de cacao · Individual” on a Merengue label with Mora type. Keep the complete wave symbol clear of the opening fold.

pages.title: Pickup location
pages.summary: Design study: organize pickup guidance around the selected day and hour. Cali is fictional project context; show no street address, map, storefront photograph or invented collection procedure.

examples.title: Recogida en tienda
examples.text: Política de ejemplo: todos los días, de 10:00 a 18:00. Elige una fecha y una franja disponible.

examples.title: Design study · Pickup guidance
examples.text: Explain today through 30 days ahead, at least one hour's notice and Bogotá time. Display hourly options through 18:00, the last pickup.

pages.title: Ordering controls
pages.summary: Design study for /pedido: distinguish editing, review and registration. Keep visible labels, 44 px targets and errors in flow. Revisar pedido remains actionable to expose linked field errors.

examples.title: Revisar pedido
examples.text: Revisa los productos, la fecha, la franja y tus datos. Este paso no registra el pedido ni reserva un cupo.

examples.title: Design study · Continuous form
examples.text: Place quantities, total and Revisar first; date/slot, name, celular and note follow. Allow 1–99 per product, 198 combined; invalid quantities hide the total.

examples.title: Design study · Explicit choices
examples.text: Show “Completa” for a full six-order slot. Preserve conflicting selections; offer another time explicitly. Review replaces editing with Registrar pedido.

pages.title: Order receipt
pages.summary: Design study for /pedido/confirmacion: show only an authorized saved result. Put status, frozen specification and pickup in one lower edge; place version references and return links afterward.

examples.title: Pedido de demostración registrado
examples.text: Estado: Recibido. Este registro no supone pago ni entrega garantizada.

examples.title: Design study · Frozen specification
examples.text: Torta de chocolate · Cantidad: 1 · Unitario: $68.000 · Subtotal: $68.000 · Total: $68.000 COP. Show the saved pickup alongside, not a second summary.

examples.title: Design study · Private reading
examples.text: Use /pedido/confirmacion?id=… with a non-secret identifier; the session grants access. Reload reads the saved order and current status, never a fabricated receipt.

pages.title: Return-visit card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a rewards card with a simple catalog reminder. Preserve the compact card format without points, stamps, membership tiers, discounts or an implied loyalty program.

examples.title: ¿Algo para otra ocasión?
examples.text: Vuelve al catálogo para consultar las tortas y los postres disponibles.

examples.title: Design study · Reminder card
examples.text: Use the wave symbol on one side and the short invitation on the other. Leave out redemption fields, reward counters and promotional codes.

pages.title: Bakery sign
pages.summary: Design study: treat signage as typographic identification, not evidence of a real shop. Use the primary signature at generous scale with a quiet descriptor and no invented opening claims.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: Tortas y postres

examples.title: Design study · Sign face
examples.text: Use Mora lettering on Merengue. Keep the waves separate from the sign edge and omit street numbers, contact details and decorative cake photographs.

pages.title: Ordering website
pages.summary: Design study: keep Inicio, Catálogo and Hacer pedido stable across public routes. This is a database-backed plan: availability, drafts, orders and owner changes must not be presented as locally simulated success.

examples.title: Encuentra tu próximo postre
examples.text: Explora el catálogo, elige los productos y revisa la recogida antes de registrar.

examples.title: Design study · Public routes
examples.text: / leads with chocolate; /catalogo filters Tortas, Postres and availability. Unknown references block Encargar until explicit selection; paused products stay recognizable.

examples.title: Design study · Private routes
examples.text: /duena/acceso leads to /duena: today's Bogotá agenda and Productos. Use Recibido → En preparación → Listo → Entregado, plus Pausar/Reactivar and Cerrar sesión.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: reuse the exact original wave geometry for the favicon, app/icon.svg and declared application icon. Use a Merengue support field, with no letters or replacement small-size mark.

examples.title: Masa Dulce — Tortas y postres para recoger
examples.text: Consulta el catálogo y prepara tu pedido de demostración.

examples.title: Design study · Browser identity
examples.text: Keep both Mora waves visible within the square. Preserve the same silhouette at 16, 32 and 48 px; never crop the lower wave.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: place a modest signature at the top and use Source Sans 3 for the document body. Echo the display with one bottom rule, not a full product scene.

examples.title: Detalle del encargo
examples.text: Productos, cantidades y recogida en una sola lectura.

examples.title: Design study · Document sheet
examples.text: Use Merengue paper color, Cacao body text and Mora headings. Keep notes separate from item rows; omit invented legal, tax and contact information.

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: use a brand introduction card without fabricated people or contact details. Put identity on the front and a concise description on the reverse, preserving generous safezones.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: Tortas para compartir y postres para recoger. Proyecto ficticio en Cali.

examples.title: Design study · Two-sided card
examples.text: Front: Mora waves and name on Merengue. Reverse: Cacao description with one Mora lower rule. Do not add a phone number, handle or QR code.

pages.title: Gift note
pages.summary: Design study: reinterpret the gift-card format as a personal enclosure, not stored value. Use a small wave signature and open writing space; add no balance, redemption code or purchasing action.

examples.title: Design study · Enclosure
examples.text: Set the greeting in Bricolage Grotesque 700 and writing labels in Source Sans 3. Keep the center clear and the Mora edge shallow.

pages.title: Packaging seal
pages.summary: Design study: center the unchanged waves on a Merengue seal and place the name separately when space allows. Treat the seal as identification, never as proof of hygiene or tamper resistance.

examples.title: Masa Dulce
examples.text: Algo para compartir

examples.title: Design study · Seal placement
examples.text: Keep the complete symbol on one flat area, away from folds. If the seal is too small for the phrase, omit the phrase rather than shrinking it into illegibility.

pages.title: Customer support
pages.summary: Design study: provide recovery beside the affected action, not through invented chat or contact services. Distinguish invalid input, conflicts, blocked access and uncertain registration without exposing private data.

examples.title: No pudimos confirmar el resultado
examples.text: Tu pedido pudo quedar registrado. Usa Recuperar para consultar la misma operación antes de editar o iniciar otro pedido.

examples.title: Revisa tu celular
examples.text: Escribe exactamente diez dígitos, empezando por 3. Conservaremos los demás datos mientras corriges este campo.

examples.title: Design study · Blocked states
examples.text: If storage or session access fails, keep visible input and offer recovery; never claim it is saved. If owner access is unconfigured, show unavailability, not a sample code.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Gracias por darle forma a Masa Dulce
examples.text: Keep the name exact, the display clear and every action honest.

examples.title: Sources and credits
examples.text: Sources are the supplied fictional project plan, catalog, policy, palette and Bricolage Grotesque and Source Sans 3 files. No public-identity sources were requested.

examples.title: Colophon
examples.text: The proposed two-wave symbol is original; product direction is code-drawn. Layouts are design studies. No real premises, photography, memberships or service guarantees are claimed.
